newsitem.title: USA: CULP COMPLETES PHILLIPS UNITS ACQUISITION.
newsitem.headline: CULP COMPLETES PHILLIPS UNITS ACQUISITION.

text.p: Culp Inc said Thursday it completed the acquisition of four upholstery fabric businesses of privately-held Phillips Industries Inc for $37 million in cash, $10 million less than it had planned on.
When Culp first announced the deal April 30, the company said it would pay $47 million in cash and notes for the Phillips units.

"When we were looking at the acquisition more closely, the projections on (the units' future earnings) were not quite as high as we expected," said general accounting manager Steven Hancock in an interview.

Hancock said the company still expected the acquisition to contribute to earnings "from day one." He added Culp will have to add to its credit line but will not need to obtain other financing to pay for the units.
The units --Phillips Weaving Mills, Phillips Velvet Mills, Phillips Printing and Phillips Mills-- posted $50 million in revenues for the year ended June 30, a company statement said.
Culp's stock traded unchanged at $18-3/16 Thursday afternoon.
